patterns.usage_note: Says that every occasion of perceiving or recalling brings on the same feeling, attaching to a dictionary-form verb (桜を見るにつけ, その話を聞くにつけて). The main clause is a reaction that arises by itself, so requests, commands, and statements of intention do not appear there. It is literary and often doubled for sweep (見るにつけ聞くにつけ, 嬉しいにつけ悲しいにつけ); 〜たびに is the neutral "every time" with no emotional coloring.

examples.ruby: 桜[さくら]を見[み]るにつけ、故郷[こきょう]の川[かわ]を思[おも]い出[だ]す。
examples.english: I never see cherry blossoms without thinking of the river back home.

examples.ruby: その話[はなし]を聞[き]くにつけて、胸[むね]が苦[くる]しくなる。
examples.english: Every time I hear that story, my chest tightens.

examples.ruby: 息子[むすこ]の成長[せいちょう]を感[かん]じるにつけ、時[とき]の速[はや]さに驚[おどろ]く。
examples.english: Each time I notice how my son has grown, I marvel at how fast time goes.
